p.fact: The language-independent core of the Discipline:

item.fact: the operating playbooks (raid, sweep, campaign form, WAL convention),
and the mechanism specs the shipped checkers implement.

p.fact: Code optimal for **comprehension and safe modification by AI agents — including weak readers** (small models in swarms maintaining frontier-authored code).

This package ships prompt content and the neutral engine crates it authors — five **library** crates (`core-ai-native-conform`, `-mcp`, `-specmap`, `-specmark`, `-specmark-grammar`); it ships no binary.

The runnable half — the checkers, the per-language cards, the guides — ships in each language stack (`stack:org.vibevm.ai-native/rust-ai-native-lang` first: `rust-ai-native-conform`, `rust-ai-native-specmap`, `rust-ai-native`, the Rust GUIDE and cards).

item.fact: `spec/00-MANIFESTO.md` — mission, axioms, the central law, §8 the package map. Start here.
`spec/01-PATTERN-CARD-FORMAT.md` — the format every pattern card is written in.
The active language stack's GUIDE (e.g. `spec/rust/GUIDE-AI-NATIVE-RUST.md` in the Rust stack).

`spec/mechanisms/` — ENGINE-CONFORM, PROP-014 (specmap), BROWNFIELD-PROTOCOL, LEDGER-INTENT, MCP-CORE: the normative mechanism specs; `spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/core-ai-native/mechanisms/…` is what code tags cite.

section.title: The two load-bearing results behind everything

item.fact: **Central law (Manifesto §3):** idiomatic inside the file, engineered around the file. Surface stays in-distribution (OOD syntax collapses models); strictness moves to types, contracts, meta, and the verification loop.

**Runnable capital (Manifesto §5):** explanation capital must be executable. Weak agents leapt from executable scaffolds, not prose. Hence the nine-class catalog — and why every procedure here is backed by a shipped tool, not a description of one.

p.fact: The central open question — does the executable-scaffold advantage transfer from *generation* to *modification* — is unproven and is the pilot's job (see `spec/appendix/CONTRADICTION-MAP.md` C-7).
A discipline that names its failure modes is more trustworthy than one that hides them.
